title: Fix cinematic moving background visibility and make it clearly animated site-wide

requirements.text: Make the site-wide CinematicBackground canvas reliably visible behind all content on every page by fixing stacking context/z-index layering so it is not rendered behind the document/background or covered by opaque section backgrounds.

quotes: the cinematic moving background is not visible, i want a proper moving background to look cinematic

acceptanceCriteria: When loading any route (Home, About, Courses, Contact, 404), the animated background is clearly visible behind the page content.
The background layer does not block clicks/scroll (pointer events remain disabled) and does not shift layout.
The background remains visible while scrolling and behind the sticky header/footer.

requirements.text: Update HeroSection so its local 'Cinematic Background' overlay does not fully obscure the global CinematicBackground (e.g., remove the opaque `bg-dark` backdrop or make it transparent/low-opacity while keeping any intended decorative overlays).

quotes: the cinematic moving background is not visible, i want a proper moving background to look cinematic

acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page hero, the global moving background remains visible and cinematic while hero text and CTAs remain readable.
No full-opaque layer in HeroSection completely blocks the site-wide animated background.

requirements.text: Improve CinematicBackground rendering quality and robustness: account for devicePixelRatio in canvas sizing, ensure the canvas covers the viewport via CSS sizing (width/height 100%), and keep animation running smoothly with safe cleanup on unmount.

quotes: the cinematic moving background is not visible, i want a proper moving background to look cinematic

acceptanceCriteria: On high-DPI displays (e.g., Retina), the background looks crisp (not blurry/pixelated).
Resizing the browser keeps the animation correctly scaled and filling the viewport without distortion.
No console errors occur related to the background animation lifecycle (mount/unmount/resize).

requirements.text: Add an accessibility/performance fallback for the cinematic background that respects `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` by rendering a static frame (or a static gradient) instead of running requestAnimationFrame.

quotes: the cinematic moving background is not visible, i want a proper moving background to look cinematic

acceptanceCriteria: If the OS/browser has reduced motion enabled, the background becomes non-animated while still visually cinematic and readable behind content.
If reduced motion is not enabled, the background animates normally.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components are read-only).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Adding new pages or new business features unrelated to the cinematic background.
Introducing a new backend canister or backend APIs (this is a frontend-only fix).
